uso: Ilustración ambiental de portada; no representa un mapa ni prueba hechos del canon.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape cover illustration for the Kuroto tabletop RPG campaign archive in the fantasy world Arghast. Create a rich, cinematic painterly fantasy landscape, horizontal 16:9. An isolated mountainous island of ancient misty forests inspired by Japanese folklore, winding mossy stone steps passing through a weathered vermilion torii on the right, warm lanterns along the path, a distant elegant shogunate castle with curved tiled roofs on a rocky hillside, deep forest and mountains behind, a large hazy copper moon in the plum twilight sky. Dark evergreen, charcoal plum, muted copper and antique gold palette. Beautiful detailed foliage, fine hand-painted textures, layered atmospheric perspective, mysterious and inviting rather than horror. Composition must leave the left third dark and softly detailed for website title overlay; the torii, stone path and distant castle sit on the right two thirds. No people or named characters, no creatures, no writing, no logos, no lettering, no watermark, no UI, no frame. This is illustrative campaign atmosphere, not a literal map.
